name: Work Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Employment letter from an SECP (Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan)-registered company, stating salary and assignment duration.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a job offer from an SECP-registered Pakistani company.

requirements.blocker_text: Extension beyond the initial entry period requires a Board of Investment (BOI) recommendation and security agency approval.

evidence_required.document: Employment letter from SECP-registered company (salary + duration)

outcome.duration_length: Entry visa: up to 3 months single entry (48-hour processing, no security clearance). Extension: up to 2 years multiple entry, requiring BOI recommendation and security clearance.

sources.title: Board of Investment, Government of Pakistan -- Work Visa: employed applicants require an employment letter from an SECP-registered company showing salary and duration; self-employed applicants require an employment agreement plus tax certification; visa validity 2 years multiple entry, standard processing 4 weeks

Directorate General of Immigration & Passports (Ministry of Interior) -- Visa Categories: Work Visa entry (up to 3 months single entry, 48-hour processing, no security clearance); extension up to 2 years multiple entries requires BOI recommendation and security approval

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Pakistan). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Board of Investment + DGI&P). work_rights set to 'restricted' rather than 'full' because the route is tied to a specific SECP-registered employer/assignment rather than an open Pakistani labour-market right. family_can_join/family_can_work: no source addressed dependents for this specific route (contrast with the separate Family Visit Visa, pk_family_reunification.json, which does cover family joining) -- family_can_join set false as the conservative non-nullable default, family_can_work left null.
